lang.label: Language
connect.note: Quick start generates a wallet in this browser — non-custodial (only you hold the key, it's just stored locally instead of in an extension), zero setup, zero XLM required.
log.heading: Activity log
console.title: Arbiter — Worker Console
console.sub: Answer paid questions, get settled on-chain automatically.
backup.heading: ⚠ Back up your quick-start key
backup.body: This wallet lives only in this browser. If you clear your browser data, use private browsing, or switch devices, any staked or accrued USDC on this address is permanently unrecoverable — there is no password reset and no support line that can get it back. Copy your secret key somewhere safe (a password manager is ideal) before you stake anything or let earnings accrue.
backup.copied: Copied to clipboard — store it somewhere safe, then clear your clipboard.
backup.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically ({error}) — reveal and copy it manually.
onboard.heading: One more step
onboard.body: Your wallet has no USDC trustline yet. Onboarding is sponsored — free, no XLM required.
practice.label: Practice mode
practice.off: Off — questions you answer are real and count toward your reputation.
practice.note: Practice mode is a client-only preview: it shows a sample question so you can try the answer flow without a real payment. Practice answers never touch the chain, your stake, or your reputation (matchRatio / totalAnswers).
categories.legend: Topics you'll answer (optional — leave all unchecked to answer everything)
demand.heading: Live demand — categories short on workers right now
push.label: Push notifications
push.off: Off — you'll only get questions while this tab is open.
push.note: Push only helps for longer-timeout questions (~20s+) — a notification round-trip is too slow for the fastest tier. It supplements the tab, it doesn't replace it.
push.unsupported: Push notifications aren't available in this app shell yet — keep the app open to receive questions.
earnings.heading: Earnings & stake
earnings.beneficiary: Payout address (optional — defaults to your own)
earnings.note: Staking is optional — it's a credibility bond. Answers that lose a quorum vote forfeit a small slice of stake to the platform; workers who never stake are never slashed.
track.heading: Your track record
track.empty: No answers yet — this fills in once you start answering.
question.heading: Incoming question
log.quickStartWallet: Using a local, browser-held quick-start wallet (non-custodial — the key never leaves this browser).
log.inAppWallet: Browser-extension wallets usually can't open inside the mobile app — use Quick start instead.
pwa.offline: You're offline — showing the saved app shell. Live questions and balances will reconnect when you're back online.
dash.title: Arbiter — Buyer Dashboard
dash.sub: See every question you've paid for — read-only, keyed by your own wallet address. No account, no signup: connect the same way you would to answer questions.
dash.proving: Proving control of your address (one signature)…
